harvestMonths.region: Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape — Afri-Star cultivar trial reference

evidence.quote: Middle to end December or 1st/2nd week January
evidence.doc: Culdevco / ARC Infruitec-Nietvoorbij, Afri-Star apple cultivar information sheet

harvestMonths.notes: Verified live 10 October 2026. The sheet explicitly limits its data to Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape and says it need not represent other areas. This is a named cultivar's harvest reference, not all apple trees or a warm KZN picking calendar.

harvestMonths.region: Elgin, Western Cape — Granny Smith cultivar first pick

evidence.doc: SAPO Trust, Granny Smith apple cultivar information sheet

harvestMonths.notes: Verified live 10 October 2026. Source table calls this the harvest date (first pick); it establishes neither the full harvest duration nor dates in another production region. SAPO is the listed South African cultivar licensee and plant-improvement authority supplying this first-party sheet.

yearsToFirstCrop.notes: No generic numeric age-to-first-crop is stated by the verified cultivar sheets. Nursery starting age, rootstock, cultivar and local establishment must be recorded; no generic curve is inferred.

yearsToFullBearing.notes: No generic numeric age-to-full-bearing is stated by the verified cultivar sheets.

yieldKgPerTreeMature.notes: Culdevco reports Afri-Star commercial production as 60–70 ton/ha but supplies no matched plant density in the sheet, so it is not converted to kg/tree. SAPO describes Granny Smith production qualitatively as high, which supplies no numeric kg/tree. Neither statement is a farm forecast.

chillUnits.notes: Afri-Star's source gives 300–500 Infruitec Chilling Units; Granny Smith's sheet uses a qualitative medium-to-low requirement. The named Afri-Star range is kept in buying advice, not assigned as one requirement for all Malus domestica cultivars. Monthly mean temperatures cannot establish accumulated cultivar chilling.

pollination.notes: The Granny Smith sheet says self-incompatible and names Golden Delicious and Hillieri pollinators. The Afri-Star sheet does not supply pollen-compatibility guidance. Keep a cultivar-specific compatible-pollen check rather than asserting one breeding-system value for every apple.

sourceChecks.regionQuote: Data obtained at Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape
sourceChecks.observations: The source attributes the cultivar to ARC Infruitec-Nietvoorbij. Its explicit regional disclaimer is retained in the reference label and notes. No whole-country early/middle/late union is shipped.
The source labels harvest as first pick and explicitly identifies Elgin, Western Cape. Its production kg/tree cell contains a qualitative adjective, not a numeric quantity.

gaps: No locally verified KZN, Highveld, Karoo or mountain apple picking window is established here. Do not copy the two Western Cape references to a mapped apple elsewhere.
The two cultivar references are alternatives; combining them would claim the picking duration of a mixed orchard rather than one apple tree.
Numeric first-bearing age, full-bearing age and kg/tree remain missing. The per-hectare Afri-Star statement has no matched density for a defensible per-tree conversion.
Chilling and pollination must be checked for the actual named cultivar and site. No single numeric requirement or universal pollination classification is assigned at species level.
Shelf life is not supplied: commercial cold-storage statements do not establish ambient household storage or automatic kept-stock months.
